description: Source code for a web scraper class 'LekkerEnSimpel' that extracts recipe information from 'lekkerensimpel.com'. It defines methods to get author, title, ingredients, instructions, and description, utilizing HTML parsing and schema data.

classes.name: LekkerEnSimpel
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from lekkerensimpel.com, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the target website.

methods.description: Extracts the author from meta tags.

methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the recipe title.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts ingredients list from various possible HTML structures or schema.
